info.title: com.clodhub/email-verification
info.description: Confirming that a shopper can read mail sent to an address: a short code kept in a records store until it expires, sent by the application, then a signed token that names the confirmed address for a while, held in a browser's cookie or sent by an app. Server only.

methods.name: normaliseEmail
methods.description: The address in the form codes are kept under: surrounding space removed and lower case. Null when it is not text, is longer than 254 characters, or is not one @ between a name and a domain with a dot.

oneOf.description: An email address in lower case without surrounding space.

methods.name: verificationPath
methods.description: The link of the verification email: the path with verify=<code> and email=<address> added to its query.

schema.description: A page path or address, such as /es/gift-cards; a query it has is kept.

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks settings; unset and unrendered values take the defaults (DEFAULT_SETTINGS).

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install, converted by settingsFrom.

methods.name: createEmailVerification
methods.description: Email verification over the store's emailCodes collection (EMAIL_CODES_COLLECTION).

methods.name: EmailVerification.ensureIndexes
methods.description: Creates the collection's indexes: email unique, and expiresAt with expireAfterSeconds 0 so the store removes codes once they expire. start also creates them before its first write.

methods.name: EmailVerification.start
methods.description: Gives the address a new code, valid for expiryMinutes, in place of any earlier one, for the application to send in an email with verificationPath. INVALID_EMAIL when normaliseEmail refuses the address; NOT_CONFIGURED, with nothing stored, when the token secret is not set.

email.description: An email address in lower case without surrounding space.

expiresAt.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: EmailVerification.confirm
methods.description: Accepts the address's current code (case and surrounding space ignored) once and before it expires, and returns a token that names the address for tokenMinutes (HMAC-SHA-256 of the address and its end, signed with the token secret), when it ends, and the Set-Cookie header value that holds it in a browser for as long (HttpOnly, SameSite Lax, Path /). An app sends the token with its purchase. A wrong, used, replaced or expired code, or an address without one, is INVALID_CODE; of two confirmations at once only one succeeds. After MAXIMUM_FAILURES (5) wrong codes the address's code is refused too, until start gives it a new one. NOT_CONFIGURED, with the code left as it was, when the token secret is not set.

email.description: An email address in lower case without surrounding space.

expiresAt.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: EmailVerification.verify
methods.description: Resolves to the address a token names; null when it is forged, altered, expired, signed with another secret, or not a token, and when the token secret is not set.

oneOf.description: An email address in lower case without surrounding space.

methods.name: EmailVerification.verifiedEmail
methods.description: Resolves to the address the token in the cookieName cookie of a Cookie request header names, as verify reads it; null without one.

oneOf.description: An email address in lower case without surrounding space.

methods.name: EmailVerification.configured
methods.description: Whether the token secret is set, so the application can say verification is closed.

tokenMinutes.description: How long a confirmation's token, and the cookie that holds it, names the address.

tokenSecretVariable.description: The environment variable that holds the secret tokens are signed with.

EmailVerificationSettings.description: How long codes are and how long they stay valid, and the token that names a confirmed address.

RawSettings.description: Settings as numbers or as the text clod renders into the settings template; missing and unrendered values take the defaults.

records.description: A records store; codes are kept in its emailCodes collection.

codes.description: The voucher-codes component's VoucherCodes; codes are its generateShort(codeLength).

env.description: Where the token secret is read, under the name tokenSecretVariable gives; the server's environment by default. Without it nothing is sent or confirmed (NOT_CONFIGURED); a secret of fewer than 32 characters (MINIMUM_SECRET_LENGTH) is refused when the service is created.

settings.description: Settings that replace the installed ones.

secure.description: Adds Secure to the cookie: true on an https site.

EmailVerification.description: Codes sent to email addresses and their confirmation, over one store.

InvalidSettings.message: RangeError: a setting is outside its range or grammar, or the token secret has fewer than 32 characters

InvalidDependencies.message: TypeError: records or codes is missing

StoreError.message: A records store error (unavailable, ...) is passed on unchanged
